description: This file is the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It initializes the React app by rendering the main 'App' component into the DOM element with id 'root', using React 18's createRoot API.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React application using React 18's concurrent rendering API.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the designated DOM container.
